name: TVmaze
tagline: Free TV show, episode, and schedule data API with no authentication required
description: TVmaze provides a free, public REST API for TV show metadata: search by name, full show details, episode lists and air dates, cast and crew, network schedules, and people credits. No API key is required for standard access; responses are JSON. Widely used for media apps, episode trackers, and TV schedule tools.

auth.details: No authentication required for the public API. Optional API key support may exist for partners; standard developer access is unauthenticated HTTPS GET requests.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public endpoints with best-effort service. CC BY-SA permits any purpose, including commercial use, provided TVmaze is credited and ShareAlike is followed. Allows at least 20 calls per 10 seconds per IP.

rate_limits: At least 20 calls every 10 seconds per IP address. Edge-cached requests may not count; temporary stricter limits may apply. Clients should back off and retry after HTTP 429.
use_cases: search TV shows by name and get primary match details
list all episodes for a show with air dates and numbers
get today's or a country's TV broadcast schedule
look up cast and crew for a show
resolve a show by IMDb or TVDB external ID
get person credits (acting/crew history) by people ID
